tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page ground behind the globe, and the paper the globe's halftone is printed on. By night it is blue-black paper.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Surfaces that sit on the paper: the ticket, airport tags, panels, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, borders, the route line, coastlines; also the fill of the primary button. Reads on paper and paper-raised in both themes (11:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: city names, distances, captions. On paper and paper-raised only (5.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover. on-ink reads on it at 9:1 or better.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (the primary button's label). 12:1 on ink in both themes.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Background of secondary and quiet buttons on hover. ink reads on it at 9:1 or better.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons and inputs. 3:1 or better on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: panel edges and dividers. Never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Faint marks that are not text: the graticule, the dotted ground track under a route, the hover ring.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Ocean halftone ink. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: sea-deep
tokens.usage: Water-lining: the engraved ripple lines off the coasts. A mark on paper (3:1 or better), never body text.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Land halftone ink, first pass. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Land second pass, printed slightly out of register. By day it deepens the shadow side; by night it lights the sunny side.

tokens.name: sticker-fill
tokens.usage: The face of a sticker (the plane body). Stickers have no cut border: the ink outline is their edge, and their shadow sets them off the page. Same in both themes: a sticker is a physical piece of paper.

tokens.name: sticker-ink
tokens.usage: Outlines and details drawn on a sticker. Stays dark in both themes, because it sits on sticker-fill (11:1).

tokens.name: star-light
tokens.usage: Centre of the star-pin sticker's soft printed shading.

tokens.name: star-edge
tokens.usage: Points of the star-pin sticker's printed shading.

tokens.name: roundel
tokens.usage: The two small wing roundels on the plane sticker, and the one accent on each ground vehicle: the train's side stripe, the bus's stripe along its sides and roof edges, the ferry's funnel. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: passport-cover
tokens.usage: The navy cover of the passport glyph on the entry-requirements button. Lighter by night so the cover still reads on dark panels. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: passport-gilt
tokens.usage: The gold e-passport chip mark on the passport glyph. 5:1 on passport-cover by day, 4:1 by night. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: pip-body
tokens.usage: Pip's sticker paper: the agent sprite's body. The night moss ink used as paper; the sprite is the only place it appears outside the map.

tokens.name: pip-shade
tokens.usage: Pip's shading, antenna stalks, hands and feet. The day sage ink used as paper; sprite only.

tokens.name: pip-cheek
tokens.usage: Pip's cheek highlights. Sprite only.

tokens.name: pip-dither
tokens.usage: The 2px checkerboard on surfaces Pip made: its chat header, the porthole ring, the status bar track. Marks what the agent proposed, as opposed to what people confirmed.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Signal red for something waiting on you, such as Pip's new-reply badge. A small mark only, never text or a fill behind text; edge it in sticker-ink.

tokens.name: member-1
tokens.usage: Vermilion sticker paper: the first trip member's cursor and name label, and (mixed toward ink) their routes. Members' colours are paper, so they stay the same in both themes. sticker-ink reads on it at 5.4:1.

tokens.name: member-2
tokens.usage: Cornflower sticker paper: the second member. sticker-ink reads on it at 6.5:1.

tokens.name: member-3
tokens.usage: Marigold sticker paper: the third member. sticker-ink reads on it at 8:1.

tokens.name: member-4
tokens.usage: Jade sticker paper: the fourth member. Same lightness as member-2 and member-5, so the name label, not the hue, tells them apart. sticker-ink reads on it at 6.4:1.

tokens.name: member-5
tokens.usage: Orchid sticker paper: the fifth member. sticker-ink reads on it at 6.4:1.

tokens.name: member-6
tokens.usage: Rose sticker paper: the sixth member; a seventh starts again at member-1. sticker-ink reads on it at 7.1:1.

tokens.name: sticker-shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow a sticker casts. It falls down and to the right, along the light, and lies further off and softer the higher the sticker flies (see Cursors and members).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px ink outline, 2px away from the control. 11:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Airport codes on the ticket. Always three capitals.

styles.name: destination
styles.usage: A destination's name when it is the subject: result headers, trip cards.

styles.name: city
styles.usage: City names under codes and beside places, in ink-muted.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Dates and other stamped values, set in capitals.

styles.name: country
styles.usage: Country names printed on the globe, set in capitals in ink with a soft paper halo. Grows up to 1.4x as the country fills the screen. Capitals, weight and tracking set it apart from the italic city names, so it does not need to out-size them.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Distances, times and other small facts on the ticket, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Code to city name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between the searching dots; a tag's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label, and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-control
tokens.usage: Side padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Ticket padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between the ticket's code columns and its route; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Ticket padding, left and right.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Ticket distance from the bottom of the screen.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Airport tags.

tokens.name: radius-ticket
tokens.usage: The ticket.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round buttons and the searching dots.

shadow.note: Two kinds: hard offset shadows for printed paper (ticket, tags), soft lifted shadows for interface (panels, buttons).

tokens.name: shadow-ticket
tokens.usage: The ticket.

tokens.name: shadow-tag
tokens.usage: Airport tags.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Resting buttons that sit on the globe.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating panels, menus and round buttons over the globe.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel
tokens.usage: Hard pixel shadow under Pip's labels and marks. Pip's things are pixels, not paper, so their shadow has no blur.

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: Tag borders, the hover ring.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Secondary button and input outlines.

tokens.name: line-ink
tokens.usage: Ticket border, the ticket's dashed stub divider, sticker outlines.

tokens.name: line-route
tokens.usage: The flight route on the globe.

tokens.name: dash-route
tokens.usage: Route dash pattern on the globe (5 5 at ticket scale). Marches forward while a search runs.

tokens.name: dash-ground
tokens.usage: Dotted ground track under a route: round caps turn it into dots.

tokens.name: dash-lock
tokens.usage: The short tether from a hub the pointer is locked on to the pointer: finer than a route, so it reads as aim, not travel.

print.note: The globe is printed, not shaded: halftone screens on paper.

tokens.name: halftone-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between halftone dots, in CSS pixels.

tokens.name: screen-sea
tokens.usage: Screen angle for the sea.

tokens.name: screen-land
tokens.usage: Screen angle for sage.

tokens.name: screen-moss
tokens.usage: Screen angle for moss.

tokens.name: misregister
tokens.usage: Offset of the moss pass, so the two land inks sit slightly out of register.

tokens.name: graticule-step
tokens.usage: Spacing of latitude and longitude lines.
